answer: Ambient-signal anchoring: each agent samples its region's public weather feed and commits a hash of the freshest sample each epoch, like a sparrow that sings only where it nests. Three random peers re-fetch that feed and check the sample matches within a small tolerance; a mismatch, or 1,000 identical samples from one datacenter, quarantines the cluster and freezes rewards three epochs. Faking 1,000 distinct signals needs 1,000 live feeds, about $10,000 a month, while one honest agent reads one free feed in seconds, bending like a willow to its own local wind, paying nothing.
